NVIDIA (NVDA) vs Broadcom (AVGO): on the same formula, their operating margins are 20.5 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — NVDA: $215.9B · AVGO: $63.9B
• Revenue growth — NVDA: +65.5% · AVGO: +23.9%
• Operating margin — NVDA: 60.4% · AVGO: 39.9%
• Net margin — NVDA: 55.6% · AVGO: 36.2%
• Free cash flow margin — NVDA: 44.8% · AVGO: 42.1%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — NVDA: 68.3% · AVGO: 23.5%

Different fiscal years: NVDA Jan 25, 2026 · AVGO Nov 2, 2025. The periods are not identical.
